The calligraphy characters "凝姿"" appear one by one, floating in from the edges of the frame in elegant brush-calligraphy style. The camera performs a micro drift to the right. The transition uses an eye-highlight white flash.

[Shot 4] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>'s hand from a diagonal top-down angle. Calligraphy text is arranged along the direction of the strings, trembling slightly in sync with the string vibrations. The camera follows the hand movement slowly. The transition uses a string light-arc flash cut.

[Shot 5] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>'s face from a low angle. She slowly lifts her gaze from downcast to level, her eyes revealing a serene depth. Golden light particles rise from the pipa. The text "拨弦" rises from the bottom of the frame in a form of converging light particles. The camera performs a slow tilt up. The transition uses a light-particle burst.

[Shot 6] At 00:09.000, the shot cuts to a medium-full shot of <Subject 1> from a frontal angle. Her robes flow with increased amplitude, lotus petals orbit around her in a gentle rotation. [Shot 7] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a close-up diagonal shot at 45 degrees of the pipa and <Subject 1>'s hand. Her fingers pluck the strings, creating light-arc ripples on the strings. A large calligraphy brush stroke sweeps diagonally from upper-left to lower-right, crossing with the string light arc. The camera performs a snap zoom gentle push. The transition uses a brush-stroke mask wipe.

[Shot 8] At 00:13.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot from behind <Subject 1>. She faces the full moon, her figure becoming a silhouette. Her robes flow toward the moonlight direction. There is no text — pure negative space. The moonlight gradually intensifies. The camera performs a slow pull back. The transition uses a moonlight gradual fill.

[Shot 9] At 00:14.000, the camera continues to pull back to a wide shot. <Subject 1>'s back view is gradually engulfed by moonlight and lotus petal light halos, dissolving into light particles. The title calligraphy text "曲尽月华收" freezes in the center of the moonlight with golden-light brush strokes. The entire frame fills with warm golden moonlight, ending on this poetic, light-filled moment.
